_readme: Sheriff-sale underwriting assumptions (set by the user 2026-11-16). Used by scripts/deal.py for the score, workbook and CRM payload, and mirrored in the CRM popup (src/lib/sheriffDeal.js). Change here and in that file together.

rehab._levels_note: Set by the user 2026-11-22: rehab = level rate x sqft. The level is guessed by scripts/rehab_level.py (county condition, listing words, price vs ARV, age, recent resale) and the team can pick it in the CRM. per_sqft ($50) is used only when no level is given.

scores._note: Flip score at the assumed winning bid: $0 profit = 0, $10k = 20, $20k = 50, $30k = 70, $45k = 90, $50k+ = 100 (straight lines between). BRRRR score: no refi with >= $200/mo = 0; $0 or less left = 100, $30k = 60, $75k+ = 0. Total = 45% BRRRR + 35% flip + up to 20 data confidence, minus penalties.

_later: Not used yet (user note 2026-11-16): the CRM already stores year-over-year home value growth by ZIP (ZipMarketData.yoy_growth_pct, Zillow ZHVI; HUD SAFMR only fills rent gaps). Candidate input for appreciation in ARV / BRRRR equity.
_transfer_tax_note: Transfer tax removed from the underwriting at the user's request (2026-11-17); replaced by a $200 sheriff closing fee on top of the $300 buy closing. Set include_transfer_tax true to bring it back.

on_market._note: On-Market page (Zillow listings): assumed purchase at 90% of list; buy costs = $2,500 closing (title, settlement) + the buyer's half of the realty transfer tax on the price (state 1% + local rates from reference/transfer_tax.json; 2% total when the municipality is unknown). No sheriff fee. Everything else (rehab, hard money, refi, operating, targets, scores) is the same as the Sheriff page. Set by Claude 2026-11-20 as a starting point; change here and in src/lib/sheriffDeal.js together.
